statement.text:
Let G be a group whose set of elements is the real numbers and which is
“nicely definable” (see below). Does G being ℵω -free imply it being free if “nicely
definable” means
    a) being Fσ ?
    b) being Borel?
    c) being analytic?
    d) being projective L[R]?
See https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0212250.pdf for justification of the restrictions.
                                                                          S. Shelah
